info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Offer Acceptance API
info.description: The Loan Offer Acceptance API enables users to formally accept a specified loan offer associated with their loan application. This functionality is crucial for transitioning the transaction from the offer stage to acceptance, allowing financial institutions to process the necessary documentation and finalize terms. Typical consumers include loan applicants and financial service representatives. The API allows them to specify the loan application and offer ID, facilitating a seamless acceptance process.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to accept a specific loan application offer identified by its unique ID. Once accepted, the offer status will be updated accordingly.

requestBody.description: Accepts an offer associated with a loan application, identified by the provided loan and offer IDs. This request should be made to confirm the acceptance of the specified offer.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication method. A bearer token is required for accessing secured resources. The token should be provided in the 'Authorization' header of the request, prefixed by the word 'Bearer'. The token is typically in JWT (JSON Web Token) format, which contains encoded information that verifies the identity of the user.
